full_prompt_en: A cinematic image shows a large studio-like space submerged in deep blue-green light, with a rippling water surface overhead and bright turquoise shafts reaching a reflective floor. A dark metal truss enters diagonally from the upper left, its lattice visible against the illuminated water. Broad beams descend from several bright overhead patches, becoming softer and wider through the teal haze. Their cyan light breaks into irregular luminous patterns across the floor. At the far left, a dark round-fronted fixture stands on a tall tripod. Coiled cables and thin stand legs cross the lower foreground, catching occasional cool edge highlights. Farther back, small box-like lights and upright stands are grouped across the middle and right. A taller human-like dark outline appears beside the right-hand equipment, while other upright forms remain indistinct within the silhouettes. The wide central gap allows the brightest light shafts and reflective patches to dominate. A few small amber-white equipment lights punctuate the cool scene near floor level, providing limited warm contrast. The ceiling-like water surface carries broken ripples and pale reflections, while the upper corners and far sides fall into blue-black darkness. The floor appears wet and glossy, with bright cyan patches interrupted by dark horizontal areas and looping cables. Soft atmospheric depth reduces distant fixtures to simple shapes; closer equipment has firmer outlines without revealing every mechanical detail. The composition layers the sloping truss, descending light, scattered stands and low reflections into an expansive space. Its immersive, unreal quality comes from the meeting of a technical studio arrangement with water-like light and suspended haze.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅电影感画面，宽阔摄影棚式空间浸在深蓝绿光中，上方有起伏水面，明亮青绿光束落向反光地面。一段深色金属桁架从左上斜入，网格在亮水体前显出。宽光束从几个顶部亮区下落，在青绿雾感中逐渐展开柔化，冷青光在地面碎裂成不规则发亮纹样。最左侧，一台正面呈圆形的深色灯具架在高三脚架上。盘绕电缆与细支架腿横过下部前景，偶尔接住冷色边光。更远处，小型箱状灯和竖向支架分组布在中部及右侧。右侧器材旁有一道较高的人形暗轮廓，其余竖立形状则在剪影中难以分清。中央宽空隙使最明亮的光束和反光占据主导。贴近地面的少量琥珀白小灯点亮冷色场景，形成有限暖色对照。顶棚般的水面带破碎波纹与浅反光，上角及远侧沉入蓝黑暗部。地面显得湿润光亮，鲜青色亮斑被暗水平区域和盘绕电缆打断。柔和空气纵深把远处器材降为简形，近处设备轮廓较实，却没有暴露全部机械细节。斜桁架、下落光线、散落支架和低处反射层叠成广阔空间，技术棚景与水般光感、悬浮雾气相遇，带来沉浸而不真实的效果。
style_prompt_en: The visual treatment combines deep blue-green shadow with broad luminous cyan shafts and liquid-like surface reflections. Bright bands widen and soften through haze, then break into irregular rippled patches on a lower plane. Sparse angular silhouettes and thin crossing lines supply scale without filling the central space. Small amber-white accents contrast gently with the dominant cool palette. Firm near edges give way to indistinct distant forms, while dark gaps preserve separation between the illuminated areas. Diagonal light and low horizontal reflections organize the depth into an expansive, immersive arrangement.
style_prompt_zh: 这种视觉处理结合深蓝绿暗部、宽阔鲜青光束与液体般表面反射。亮带穿过雾感后展开柔化，在下部平面碎裂为不规则波纹亮斑。稀疏棱角剪影和细交叉线提供尺度，却不填满中央空间。少量琥珀白点缀与主导冷色谱形成轻微对照。近处实边逐步过渡为远处模糊形体，暗隙保持各亮区分离。斜向光线和低位水平反光组织纵深，形成广阔沉浸的布局。
theme_en: A submerged studio-like space with turquoise light shafts and silhouetted equipment
theme_zh: 青绿色光束与器材剪影交织的水下摄影棚式空间
name: Underwater lighting
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
